title: ClearPath Standard Seat Rate on an Upgrade From ClearPath Essentials
content:
**Rate clause.** The upgraded rate of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement moving from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard is the ClearPath Standard list rate, 124.00 USD per seat, reduced by the ClearPath Standard term discount for the agreement's current term length, rounded half up to the cent:

| Current term | ClearPath Standard term discount | Upgraded rate |
|---|---|---|
| 12 months | 0.0 percent | 124.00 |
| 24 months | 2.0 percent | 124.00 less 2 percent, that is 121.52 |
| 36 months | 4.0 percent | 124.00 less 4 percent, that is 119.04 |

The current term length is the term length on the agreement.

**Order of assembly.** The values and the method used are fixed first; any percentage discounts are then added into one combined percentage, applied once, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

**Example (hypothetical agreement).** A ClearPath Essentials agreement on a 24-month term at its contracted rate upgrades to ClearPath Standard at 121.52 per seat; on a 36-month term it upgrades at 119.04.
